Around [[4043 BBY]], the two [[Dark Council]]ors [[Darth Qalar]] and [[Darth Victun]] fought a '''Kaggath''' in the [[Imperial Citadel (Sith Empire)|Imperial Citadel]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. The [[Kaggath]] tore the Citadel to the ground, and when the dust settled the other ten members of the Council promptly [[Death/Legends|killed]] both Qalar and Victun. The Citadel's rebuilding would be overseen by [[Darth Nostrem]], who built it according to designs provided by the Dark Council and the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]].
